say:2:1321801002:1.text: Good day to you, Mr. Faramor. What brings you here?
say:2:1321801002:1.source_cn: 向您问好，法拉莫尔先生，你在这做什么？

say:3:1321801003:1.text: I'm picking up some food and other essentials for my upcoming journey.
say:3:1321801003:1.source_cn: 我来买些食材杂物，为后面的行程准备补给品。

say:4:1321801004:2.text: Are you leaving Whiteridge soon, Mr. Faramor?
say:4:1321801004:2.source_cn: 啊，法拉莫尔先生，您要离开白山公国了吗？

say:5:1321801005:1.text: Yes. Now that the festival has ended and the undead threat has been dealt with, my work here is finished. It's time I resumed my search for the one responsible for harming my homeland.
say:5:1321801005:1.source_cn: 是的，祭典已经结束，你们也找到了安抚活死人的方法，我不...

say:7:1321801006:1.text: Seeing you all again has made me a little sentimental. The town may look the same, but so much has changed beneath the surface.
say:7:1321801006:1.source_cn: 刚刚看到诸位，又让我心生感慨，这里看似跟之前一样，但很...

say:8:1321801007:1.text: The endless time loop... It feels like it was only yesterday. Sometimes, when I wake up, I wonder if I'll find myself back on the day we first met.
say:8:1321801007:1.source_cn: 那段往复的祭典似乎还在昨天，有时候我在想……一觉醒来后...

say:9:1321801008:1.text: Who would have thought that a few chance encounters would go on to change the future of Whiteridge?

choice_prompt:10:1321801008.text: Who would have thought that a few chance encounters would go on to change the future of Whiteridge?
choice_prompt:10:1321801008.source_cn: 我邀请诸位到小屋，然后告诫这里的危险。可谁能想到呢？偶尔路遇的几位朋友，却改变了白山的未来。

say:11:1321801009:1.text: Not at all. I'm genuinely impressed by everything you've accomplished.
say:11:1321801009:1.source_cn: 并非奉承，你们的确做到了很多令我叹为观止的事。

say:12:1321801012:1.text: Both the duchy itself and its people have changed. As for me, the Frost Furie incident has given me a new perspective on the Graveborn.
say:12:1321801012:1.source_cn: 白山也因为这些事改变了，无论是公国本身还是人们的思想都...

say:13:1321801013:1.text: They belong to the shadows, but light and shadow are both part of nature's balance.
say:13:1321801013:1.source_cn: 亡灵天生就藏在自然秩序的阴影中。可光与影，都该是自然的...

say:14:1321801014:1.text: Before I leave, I'd like the chance to speak with the Graveborn here—to hear their thoughts on life and nature.

choice_prompt:15:1321801014.text: Before I leave, I'd like the chance to speak with the Graveborn here—to hear their thoughts on life and nature.
choice_prompt:15:1321801014.source_cn: 如果可以的话，我很想在离开白山公国之前，和这里的亡灵认识一下，和他们聊聊关于生命和自然的看法。

say:16:1321801015:1.source_cn: 您真是敏锐，我正是此意。
